args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The docstring specified banker's rounding but the implementation used
ROUND_HALF_UP, causing tests/test_money.py to fail. Switch the rounding
mode to ROUND_HALF_EVEN.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was documented as banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212) but implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py`.

## Changes
- Switch the rounding mode in `round_money` from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix-bankers-rounding` (sha 08d3cd5986) passed, including `tests/test_money.py`.
